questions.prompt:
A city replaced several public parking spaces with small gardens. Supporters predicted cleaner air and more social contact. Six months later, researchers found that residents spent more time outdoors near the gardens. However, air-quality readings had not changed significantly. The researchers cautioned that the observation did not prove the gardens alone caused the increase in outdoor activity: a new cafe had opened nearby at the same time. They recommended comparing similar streets before expanding the policy.

Which outcome was observed after six months?
options: A significant improvement in air quality.
More outdoor activity near the gardens.
The removal of every parking space.
questions.explanation: 实际观测是 spent more time outdoors；空气质量未显著变化，不能把预测当作结果。

questions.prompt:
A company offered employees the option of working from home two days a week. After a year, managers reported that staff turnover had fallen. Productivity, measured by completed tasks, remained broadly stable. The report did not examine whether all tasks required the same effort, nor did it include employees who had left before the policy began. Although the results were encouraging, the authors argued that these limitations should be addressed before the findings were applied to other workplaces.

What changed after the policy was introduced?
options: All employees worked remotely every day.
questions.explanation: 文中 staff turnover had fallen 意为员工流失率下降；生产率只是大体稳定。
